UI_trait_SHAW_EpilepticDesc: Seizures brought on by stress, exhaustion, direct light or screens. You drop where you stand, convulse, and make noise doing it.
UI_trait_SHAW_NarcolepticDesc: You fall asleep without warning, wherever you happen to be. A heavy meal or deep fatigue makes it likelier. Damage wakes you.
UI_trait_SHAW_DiabeticDesc: Blood sugar you have to manage. Too low and you black out; too high and you burn out. Insulin becomes as precious as ammunition.
UI_trait_SHAW_DepressiveDesc: Depression rises faster and lifts harder. At its worst you stop noticing hunger, and sometimes you simply do not swing.
UI_trait_SHAW_ImmunocompromisedDesc: Every wound turns septic without antibiotics, illness takes hold easily, and the Knox Virus turns you on the spot - no grace period.
UI_trait_SHAW_AsthmaticDesc: Less endurance and slow recovery. Your breathing carries once you are winded, and a long run can bring on an attack.
UI_trait_SHAW_EhlersDanlosDesc: Loose joints. A leg can cramp severely and give out mid-sprint, and the soreness lingers far longer than it should.
UI_trait_SHAW_NeuralgiaDesc: Bolts of excruciating pain, several times a day, without warning. Everything stops until it passes.
UI_trait_SHAW_TouretteDesc: An involuntary vocal tic at the worst possible moment. It carries as far as a shout, and stress makes it more frequent.
UI_trait_SHAW_AllergyDesc: Spring in the woods makes you sneeze, and every sneeze carries. Peanuts make you sick. Antihistamines help, while they last.
UI_trait_SHAW_ArthritisDesc: Stiff joints. You swing slower, your hands tire faster in a long fight, and cold weather makes all of it worse.
UI_trait_SHAW_ADHDDesc: One random skill trains fifteen times faster - but reading takes three times as long, stress and boredom pile up, and past a point you refuse to sit still.
UI_trait_SHAW_ColorBlindDesc: The world reaches you in shades of grey.
